page.layout: One title page: centred title block at the top, a small printer's device (woodcut) in the middle, and the imprint at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: The title block is heavily show-through from the reverse side, so the lines below the first two are mostly unreadable. The lines marked illegible are mirrored text from the other page and could not be read reliably. The first two lines (ASSERTIO, LAMBERTI DANAEI) are clear. The imprint date and town are read with some doubt. The device is a woodcut with no text, and a vertical side line of mirrored print appears at the right of it. No page number or running head is printed.
